patch_description: Merge the even/odd RY parameter split in the initial rotation layer into a single unified "ry" parameter. This reduces distinct parameters from 7 to 5, following the pattern that showed 0.36 worst-group margin with 6 params. Extreme parameter sharing should force better generalization and robustness on the hardest validation samples (worst-group margin), which is the dominant score component. The prior program achieved better performance with fewer distinct parameters, suggesting that parameter economy is more important than fine-grained expressivity for this task.
